title: Cygames Is Now a Premium Partner to the Qatar Prix de L’Arc de Triomphe
content:
Cygames, Inc., the company behind the Umamusume: Pretty Derby franchise, is now a Premium Partner to Qatar Prix de l’Arc de Triomphe. This partnership marks the first time a Japanese company has attained Premium Partner status with the prestigious race. As part of the sponsor partnership, the Cygames logo will be featured on the race programs and trackside signage at the Qatar Prix de l’Arc de Triomphe.

Additionally, life-size statues of Umamusume ‘s Goldship and Orfevre will be placed at Paris Longchamp Racecourse during the race. Both horses competed in the race: Goldship finished 14th in 2014, and Orfevre placed 2nd in 2012.

Guillaume de Saint-Seine , the President of France Galop, said the following about the partnership:

“We are delighted to welcome Cygames, a video game developer and publisher, as a Premium Partner of the Qatar Prix de l’Arc de Triomphe. Having been the title sponsor of the Cygames Grand Prix de Paris for the past two years, Cygames is now further strengthening its commitment to French racing through this new partnership. I am particularly pleased to see our collaboration expand, helping to showcase the excellence and image of French racing to new audiences. This commitment also demonstrates our ability to attract partners from sectors far beyond the horse racing industry by offering platforms that address genuine brand-building, visibility, and business development objectives.”

Koichi Watanabe , Cygames’ president, also commented on the partnership:

“We are immensely proud to support one of the world’s most prestigious horse races as a Premium Partner of the Qatar Prix de l’Arc de Triomphe. For generations, Japanese horses have pursued the dream of winning the Arc, and their stories have transcended the world of horse racing, inspiring people around the globe through the dreams and passion that this iconic race continues to embody. At Cygames, we strive to share these same dreams and passion with audiences worldwide by delivering the very best in entertainment. With this mission at heart, we are proud to support the Arc and hope that as many people as possible will be able to experience and enjoy this exceptional event and its world-class festivities.”

Prix de l’Arc de Triomphe in Paris & Umamusume: Pretty Derby Details

The Société d’Encouragement inaugurated the Prix de l’Arc de Triomphe in Paris, France, in 1920. Since then, the Prix de l’Arc de Triomphe has become one of Europe’s most prestigious horse races. The 2400-meter (1 mile 4 furlongs) turf race is run at the Longchamp Racecourse in Paris and boasts the largest purse of any European race, with a €5,000,000 (~ $5,819,000 / ¥900,000,000) purse. This race is scheduled for October fourth. Following Qatar’s 2008 major sponsorship of the race, it was renamed the Qatar Prix de l’Arc de Triomphe.

The Qatar Prix de l’Arc de Triomphe is open to three-year-old and up thoroughbred horses. This year, the France Galop allowed geldings to join the race.

Cygames’ Umamusume: Pretty Derby franchise features anthropomorphic versions of real-life racehorses. Originally a mobile game, Umamusume has since been adapted into several TV anime, OVAs, manga, theatrical films, and additional video games.

title: Mari Okazaki's Will I Be Single Forever? Manga Gets 2nd Live-Action Film
content:
The official X/Twitter account for the live-action film of Mari Okazaki 's Will I Be Single Forever? ( Zutto Dokushin de Iru Tsumori? ) manga announced on Thursday that the manga will have a second film titled Tenten Zutto Dokushin de Iru Tsumori? The film will debut streaming exclusively on Amazon Prime Video on October 23.

The new film will have an original story. The film centers on the carefree and aimless 30-year-old Yamada, the unsociable 38-year-old Shiba, and the career minded 46-year-old Shimizu. The film will follow all three individuals' single lives and their choices in life.

The cast includes Sumi Morika as Yamada, Ryūya Wakaba as Shiba, and Yū Kashii as Shimizu. Other cast members include Haruka Imō, Kentarō Tamura , Tomo Kasajima, Asuka Kurosawa , Kazuko Shirakawa , Hidekazu Mashima , and Gin Maeda.

Yūko Hakota is directing the film. Takehiko Minato is penning the script. Takuma Watanabe is composing the music.

The first Will I Be Single Forever? live-action film opened in Japan in November 2021.

Okazaki launched the manga in Feel Young in November 2014, and ended it in October 2015. The manga's premise is based on Mami Amamiya 's essay of the same name. Shodensha published one compiled book volume for the manga. Viz Media released the manga in 2018.

Okazaki is best known for her workplace romance Suppli , which ran in Shodensha 's Feel Young magazine from 2003 to 2009. Tokyopop published five volumes of the series. The manga inspired a live-action television series in Japan in 2006.

Okazaki's Kashimashi Meshi manga inspired a live-action series in April 2023.

title: Live-Action Sins of Kujo Film's Teaser Reveals More Cast
content:
The official website for the live-action film of Shohei Manabe 's Kujō no Taizai (Sins of Kujo) manga began streaming a new teaser trailer for the film on Thursday. The teaser reveals more cast members for the film.

The new cast members include:

• Kiyohiko Shibukawa (top row left in image above) as Takehito Mitarashi, the sworn brother of yakuza crime boss Kyōgoku

• Haru Kuroki (top row center) as Kanako Kujō, Taiza Kujō's ex-wife, who is raising a daughter as a single mother

• Yui Narumi (top row right) as Rui Ōta, a dating app swindler who hires Taiza Kujō as a lawyer

• Eita Okuno (bottom row left) as Uji, a young yakuza lieutenant

• Mutsuo Yoshioka (bottom row center) as Karigane, an aide of the head of the Fushimi group yakuza

• Yū Tokui (bottom row right) as Kajiya, a former member of a militant yakuza group

The film will open in Japan on January 8, 2027.

Yuuya Yagira (live-action Gintama , Aoi Honō , Crows Explode ) is reprising his role from the previous television series as Taiza Kujō, along with Hokuto Matsumura ( Suzume , live-action xxxHOLiC , 5 Centimeters Per Second ) as Shinji Karasuma.

The staff and other cast members from the live-action series are also returning for the film. In particular, Nobuhiro Doi (live-action In This Corner of the World ) returns to direct the film based on a script by Nonji Nemoto (live-action Ya Boy Kongming! ).

The manga centers on Kujō, a lawyer who would even defend the devil. In the new Reiwa era where chaos is spreading, he is the "guardian of darkness" who operates behind the scenes.

Netflix describes the story of the live-action series:

Does defending the greyest of the grey make him a just lawyer or a wicked one? This crime drama will make you rethink everything you know about law and morality. Kujo Taiza is a lawyer who defends only society's worst, including thugs and ex-convicts. When elite lawyer Shinji Karasuma finds himself working for Kujo, he is quickly shocked by the man's unconventional style that doesn't adhere to standard ethics. As they represent clients with cases that reflect the gritty underbelly of society, Karasuma comes to realize Kujo's conviction but struggles to grasp his idea of justice, which he will stop at no grey method to achieve. He must decide if Kujo is truly a wicked lawyer or not.

Manabe launched the manga in Shogakukan 's Weekly Big Comic Spirits magazine in October 2020. Shogakukan published the manga's 16th compiled book volume on April 2, and the series has more than 4 million copies in circulation so far.

Netflix 's live-action series of the manga premiered on April 2.

Manabe launched the Ushijima the Loan Shark manga in Weekly Big Comic Spirits in 2004, and ended the series in March 2019. The manga's 46th and final volume shipped in May 2019. The manga won in the General category of the 56th Shogakukan Manga Awards in 2011. The series was nominated for an Osamu Tezuka Culture Prize in 2008 and 2010, as well as for France's Angoulême Comics Awards in 2008.

The Ushijima the Loan Shark manga's live-action television series adaptation ran from October-December 2010, and the first film opened in August 2012. A second season premiered in January 2014, with a second film then premiering in May 2014. The third season premiered in July 2016, while the third film opened in Japan in September 2016. The fourth and final live-action film , Yamikin Ushijima-kun The Final , opened in Japan in October 2016. A live-action spinoff series titled Yamikin Ushijima-kun Gaiden Yamikin Saihara-san ( Ushijima the Loan Shark Side Story: Saihara the Loan Shark) premiered in Japan in September 2022.

title: Xbox Game Studios Takes Over Publishing Hideo Kojima's Physint Action Espionage Game
content:
Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) announced on Wednesday that it will no longer publish Hideo Kojima and Kojima Productions ' Physint action espionage game . On the same day, Microsoft 's Xbox Game Studios announced that it is taking over publishing for the game.

Kojima elaborated on his X/Twitter account on the same day that he got a notice from SIE in mid-June earlier this year that SIE was canceling Physint . Kojima and his game studio spent the last three months searching for a new partner for the game project, eventually landing on Xbox Game Studios.

Kojima and Kojima Productions are also developing the new horror game OD KNOCK alongside Xbox Game Studios.

Physint will star Australian actress and model Charlee Fraser ( Anyone but You, Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga ), Korean-American actor and producer Don Lee ( Train to Busan, Eternals ), and Japanese actress Minami Hamabe (live-action Kakegurui - Compulsive Gambler , Shin Kamen Rider , Godzilla Minus One ).

Kojima Productions stated in September 2025 that the game was still in the early planning stages, as the company was focusing on producing the OD KNOCK horror game.

Kojima's Death Stranding game shipped for PlayStation 4 in November 2019. The game launched on PC via Steam in July 2020 after a delay from June 2020 due to COVID-19. Death Stranding: Director's Cut , the PlayStation 5 version of the game, launched in September 2021. Death Stranding: Director's Cut launched for PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store in March 2022. Death Stranding: On the Beach , the second game, launched for PlayStation 5 in June 2025, and launched on PC via Steam and Epic Game Store on March 19.

The game is inspiring a film adaptation at Hammerstone Studios ( Barbarian, Bill and Ted Face the Music ). Director Michael Sarnoski ( Pig, A Quiet Place: Day One ) is set to write and direct the film.

As a separate project, the franchise is inspiring a new adult animated feature set in the universe of the game. The animated film will tell an original story. Hiroshi Miyamoto ( Eiga Precure Dream Stars! , Hugtto! Precure Futari wa Precure All Stars Memories ) is directing the project at ABC ANIMATION STUDIO . The film's working title is DEATH STRANDING MOSQUITO .

Another separate project, an anime series titled Death Stranding Isolations , will debut in 2027 on Disney+ .

title: Tokyo Gap-Financing Market Highlights 5 Animation Projects Seeking More Funding
content:
On Wednesday, TIFFCOM 2026 and the Tokyo International Film Festival highlighted 24 film projects, including five animated ones, that the 7th Tokyo Gap-Financing Market (TGFM) event will feature on October 28-30.

The projects include two Japanese animated projects: Ayumi Moriyama and OLM 's Mahora, and YKBX and P.I.C.S. ' Princess Zonof . Other Japanese projects include Nagoya Broadcasting Network 's Brackish Zone (working title), an unnamed Toei project, LesPros Entertainment 's Where We Bury the Pigeon , and Wild Zero director Tetsuro Takeuchi's Wild Zero Overdrive.

The full list of projects can be found on the TGFM website .

The TGFM showcases projects which have reached funding for at least 60% of their budgets, providing opportunities for one-on-one meetings with industry experts for further development and budget fulfillment.

The first pitch event will take place on October 28 with 10 of these titles.

title: Pikmin 4 Game Gets Switch 2 Edition, Dandori Academy Mode
content:
Nintendo announced during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Wednesday that Pikmin 4 , the first new main game in the Pikmin series in a decade, will get a Switch 2 edition on November 12. The new Dandori Academy mode will also launch on the same day.

The Dandori Academy mode adds challenges and puzzles at three difficulty levels available on the weekend. Players can rank themselves against others on a global leaderboard.

The Switch 2 edition will launch physically and digitally with an upgrade pack on the Nintendo Store and eShop. Pre-orders are available now.

The game shipped for the Switch in July 2023.

Nintendo describes the game:

Meet Pikmin, small, plantlike creatures you can grow, pluck, command, and overpower your enemies with! These curious helpers come in different types—fire is no sweat for Red Pikmin and the brand-new Ice Pikmin can freeze enemies and the environment. Use your Pikmin's miniature might (and a bit of strategy) to explore this mysterious planet. You get a dog, too! Oatchi (pronounced oat-chee), resident good boy and dependable partner, can help with things like smashing obstacles and carrying Pikmin throughout your adventure. With the miniscule Pikmin and a capable canine in tow, no challenge is too big!

Nintendo also added Pikmin 1+2 , an HD release of the first two games in its Pikmin series, on the Switch digitally in June 2023 and later physically in September 2023.

The Pikmin series of strategy games allows players to control creatures called Pikmin in an effort to explore an unknown planet and survive against predatory adversaries, using the special properties of each kind of Pikmin to navigate the game environment.

Nintendo released the first game in the series on the Nintendo GameCube in 2001. Nintendo released Pikmin 3 , on the Wii U in 2013. The side-scrolling action-adventure game Hey! Pikmin shipped for Nintendo 3DS in July 2017 in Japan, North America, and Europe. Nintendo released the Pikmin 3 Deluxe version for the Switch in 2020. Pokemon GO developer Niantic released the free-to-play AR (augmented reality) game Pikmin Bloom worldwide in October 2021.

With the miniscule Pikmin and a capable canine in tow, no challenge is too big!
Nintendo also added Pikmin 1+2 , an HD release of the first two games in its Pikmin series, on the Switch digitally in June 2023 and later physically in September 2023.

The Pikmin series of strategy games allows players to control creatures called Pikmin in an effort to explore an unknown planet and survive against predatory adversaries, using the special properties of each kind of Pikmin to navigate the game environment.

Nintendo released the first game in the series on the Nintendo GameCube in 2001. Nintendo released Pikmin 3 , on the Wii U in 2013. The side-scrolling action-adventure game Hey! Pikmin shipped for Nintendo 3DS in July 2017 in Japan, North America, and Europe. Nintendo released the Pikmin 3 Deluxe version for the Switch in 2020. Pokemon GO developer Niantic released the free-to-play AR (augmented reality) game Pikmin Bloom worldwide in October 2021.

title: Star Fox Remake Game Gets Free Update, Star Fox Adventures Added to Nintendo Classics
content:
Nintendo announced during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Wednesday that Star Fox , a remake of Star Fox 64 with new graphics, new art style, a multiplayer option, and other gameplay additions, will get a free update to the Battle Mode on September 29. The company also added the 2002 Star Fox Adventures game to the library of the Nintendo GameCube – Nintendo Classics Switch Online Expansion Pack on the same day.

Star Fox Battle Mode Update Trailer

Star Fox Adventures Trailer

The update for Battle Mode will include split screens, new stages, four-player gameplay on a single Switch 2 game system, and more.

The game launched on Nintendo Switch 2 on June 25.

The game retains the layout and general mechanics of the 1997 Star Fox 64 Nintendo 64 game. The remake adds new cinematic briefings and fully voiced dialogue to the game's Campaign Mode, as well as a new orchestral soundtrack. The campaign has three difficulty levels. The game adds a Challenge Mode, where players can replay already completed levels with additional objectives, and in two different difficulty levels. Both Campaign and Challenge Mode are compatible with Joy-Con 2 Mouse Controls, and allows two different players to cooperate in piloting and gunnery duties either on the same system, or GameShare via GameChat.

Star Fox has a multiplayer Battle Mode that allows for 4-on-4 fights on three different game types. The game supports online matchmaking, private custom matches, and online play via GameShare via GameChat. Players can use a camera with GameChat for interactive avatars based on the game's characters.

Star Fox 64 , itself a reimagining of the 1993 SNES Star Fox game, launched on the Nintendo 64 in 1997. The game already has two remakes: Star Fox 64 3D for Nintendo 3DS in 2011, and Star Fox Zero for Wii U in 2016. Nintendo released the game digitally on Switch via its Nintendo Classics service in 2021.

Star Fox Adventures launched for the Nintendo GameCube in 2002. The story is set eight years after the events of Star Fox 64 .

Star Fox series protagonist Fox McCloud appeared in The Super Mario Galaxy Movie , which opened on April 1.

title: Masami Kurumada to Publish Saint Seiya Tenkai-hen Manga's 4th Part on December 18
content:
Akita Publishing 's Champion RED magazine announced on Wednesday that Masami Kurumada will publish the fourth part of the Saint Seiya Tenkai-hen ( Saint Seiya : The Heavens Arc) manga under the title " Saint Seiya Tenkai-hen Then IV " in the magazine's February issue on December 18. (The magazine's social media announcement included a text caption saying the date is December 16, but the announcement's image lists the correct date of December 18.)

The new Saint Seiya Tenkai-hen series is described as the "official" sequel of the Saint Seiya and Saint Seiya: Next Dimension - The Myth of Hades manga. The 2004 Saint Seiya Tenkai-hen Jōsō ~Overture~ film was also described as the official sequel to the Saint Seiya: Next Dimension - The Myth of Hades manga.

The " Saint Seiya Then" installments are also a sequel to the Saint Seiya : Next Dimension manga. Kurumada published the first " Saint Seiya Then: Haikyō no Hana" (Flowers of Ruin) installment in Weekly Shōnen Champion in November 2024, and published the second installment " Saint Seiya Then II: Shimei" (Mission) in Akita Shoten 's Champion RED magazine on December 19.

Kurumada launched the third part of the " Saint Seiya Then" manga on May 14.

Kurumada published the original Saint Seiya manga from 1986 to 1990. The manga has inspired a number of television anime, original video anime projects, anime films, and spinoff manga. The original series has 35 million copies in print.

Saint Seiya: Next Dimension - The Myth of Hades launched in 2006 and ended in July 2024.

Viz Media published the original manga in English under the title Saint Seiya: Knights of the Zodiac . ADV Films released Toei Animation 's anime adaptation with an English dub under the title Knights of the Zodiac , and later released it unedited under the title Saint Seiya . New Video Group later also released the series on DVD.

Knights of the Zodiac: Saint Seiya , the CG anime remake based on the original manga, debuted worldwide in July 2019. Saint Seiya: Knights of the Zodiac - Battle for Sanctuary - , the second season , debuted in July 2021. Saint Seiya: Knights of the Zodiac - Battle for Sanctuary - Part 2 , the next part , premiered in April 2024.

A live-action film of the manga titled Knights of the Zodiac opened in 2023.

Kurumada announced in a press conference in Tokyo on September 2 that he has filed a lawsuit against a former board director and others from three of his companies for allegedly misappropriating funds without authorization. He is seeking an estimated 2.8 billion yen (about US$18 million) in damages.

title: Major Shonen Jump Anime Hit Confirms Season 2 Return Date – Watch Trailer
content:
The exciting Fall 2026 anime season is almost here, and it’s going to be the biggest quarter of the year. With the return of Black Clover and The Apothecary Diaries , the season is already packed with exciting shows to keep fans entertained for the rest of the year. Among the sequels this season, one of them includes a beloved Shonen Jump anime, which is all set for its return next month. Written and illustrated by Hitsuji Gondaira, Mission: Yozakura Family began serialization in Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in 2019 and gained attention for its wholesome family dynamic as it blends action and comedy into the story. The manga released an anime adaptation in 2024, gaining further popularity for its story.

While it wasn’t among the biggest anime debuts of the year, the series gained enough recognition to get renewed for a second season. The anime is all set to return with Part 2 of the second season on October 11th as part of the Fall 2026 lineup. The sequel was already confirmed to be released this year, and now that September is already here, the official X handle of the anime locked down the release date. The anime also shared a brand new trailer featuring all the information you need to know before watching the second part of Season 2.

What to Expect From Mission: Yozakura Family Season 2 Part 2

The first part of Season 2 was released in April this year as part of the Spring 2026 anime lineup. It aired 12 episodes until June 2026, so we can expect the same episode count for the second part as well. The anime will begin streaming internationally on Hulu, but so far, we can only expect the subbed episodes. The release date of the English dub episodes will be revealed at a later date, most likely around next month when the anime returns with new episodes.

Season 2 hasn’t revealed any changes in the cast and crew, so Takahiro Nakatsugawa will be returning as the director for this season as well. Additionally, Mirai Minato will be handling the scripts, while Mirai Minato is responsible for the character designs. The voice actors will also return for this season as well and the voices behind any new characters will be revealed in the same episode as the character’s debut.

What’s Happening in Mission: Yozakura Family Season 2?

While the manga has already reached its conclusion in 2025, the anime has a huge chunk of story left to adapt. The first part of Season 2 adapted the Silver Rank Exam Arc. It also introduced the Kawashita Interrogation Arc, but ended on a major cliffhanger, leaving several unanswered questions.

The arc is only seven chapters long, so the second part will wrap it up within the first couple of episodes. Additionally, the story will move on to the Yozakura Roots Arc, where the characters find a completely different Yozakura family. The upcoming episodes will completely turn the story around with more excitement and chaos than ever.
